posts.text:
I spent the last few weeks testing local AI models, and one thing surprised me.

The bottleneck wasn't model quality. It was my evaluation loop.

Once I wrote failing tests for generic phrasing, the drafts got sharper fast.

What part of your workflow is quietly limiting quality?

I built a RAG chatbot last quarter and kept making the same mistake.

I added more context instead of better questions.

Retrieval got noisier. Answers got vaguer.

The fix was boring: tighter chunking and an explicit 'I don't know' path.

I almost shipped a feature nobody asked for.

It looked impressive in demos. It created support debt in week one.

Now I ask one question before building: what broken workflow does this replace?
